name: @devdigest/mcp
description: DevDigest MCP server — exposes the local review loop to a coding agent over stdio. Another HTTP client of the API on :3001: no database, no import from server/src. Unlike reviewer-core it EMITS JS, because it is launched as a process by another program rather than imported as source.

scripts.inspector: npm run build && npx --yes @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@2.1.0 node dist/index.js
